review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source image with nine evenly spaced decoded frames in the Veo motion-only contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Rechecked the recorded MP4 digest, byte size, dimensions, duration, frame count, frame rate and absence of audio.

observations.requested_motion: The central purple aura should continuously contract and fade outside-in, ending as a small faint halo while every other element remains unchanged.
observations.camera: The camera stays fixed, but the square source is pillarboxed inside a 16:9 frame with black side bars.
invariant_failures: The purple aura first intensifies and expands into a large saturated bloom before fading; the motion is not a continuous contraction.
The square source is presented with black pillarbox bars in a 16:9 frame instead of retaining source framing.

verdict.summary: The aura grows and brightens before fading, and the square infographic is pillarboxed in 16:9; the result fails the requested motion and framing fidelity.
